# Samori Systems (samori.co.uk)

> UK-focused tech reviews: consumer electronics, smart home and software, with UK pricing (£) and UK retailer availability. Specifications and prices come from manufacturer information; see the editorial policy.

## Reviews

- [Tangem Wallet Review](https://www.samori.co.uk/tangem/): Card-based NFC crypto hardware wallet.
- [Keurig K-Mini Review](https://www.samori.co.uk/keurig/): Compact single-serve pod coffee maker.
- [Amazon Echo Dot Review](https://www.samori.co.uk/echo-dot/): Budget Alexa smart speaker.
- [Apple AirPods Pro 3 Review](https://www.samori.co.uk/airpods-pro-3/): Flagship noise-cancelling wireless earbuds.
- [Logitech G305 Lightspeed Review](https://www.samori.co.uk/logitech-g305/): Lightweight wireless gaming mouse.
